plainText:
Minori Suzuki (Japanese: 鈴木みのり Minori Suzuki) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Suzuki was born in Aichi Prefecture, Japan on Oct 1, 1997. Her voicing acting career started in , where was chosen out of 8000 people, having previously done no voice acting work. She had her first voicing role in the as Regina in , before eventually getting the major voice acting role of Liko, one of the protagonists of .
